results.content:
The American Association of Individual Investors has conducted the AAII Sentiment Survey since 1987. The survey asks individual investors where they think the market is heading over the next six months and has done so since 1987. Bearish sentiment has now outweighed bullish sentiment for six consecutive weeks. The last time bearish sentiment outweighed bullish sentiment was in April, just before equities enjoyed a multi-week run.
